ja365:1.1: hoti nippāpo dhammapītirasaṃ pivan ti. Vutto 'mhi samma sumukha jūte akkhaparājito, sevehi ambapakkāni, viriyan te bhakkhayāmase ti.
ja365:2.1: Alikaṃ vata maṃ samma abhūtena pasaṃsayi, ko te suto vā diṭṭho vā sumukho nāma makkaṭo.
ja365:3.1: Ajjāpi me taṃ manasi yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ ahiguṇḍika dhaññāpaṇaṃ pavisitvā matto chātaṃ hanāsi maṃ.
ja365:4.1: T' āhaṃ saraṃ dukkhaseyyaṃ api rajjam pi kāraye n' eva taṃ yācito dajjaṃ, tathā hi bhayatajjito.
ja365:5.1: Yañ ca jaññā kule jātaṃ gabbhe tittaṃ amacchariṃ tena sakkhiñ ca mittañ ca dhīro sandhātum arahatīti.
